spotify_screen.purpose: A visually striking music player interface synced with Spotify.

layout.album_art: Left side (120x120 centered vertically): Large square area for RGB565 album art stream.
layout.track_info: Right side (160x100): vertically stacked track title (large, max 2 lines), artist name (medium), and album name (small).
layout.progress_bar: Right side bottom (160x20): Thin horizontal line with a filled portion and a floating playhead dot. Current time / total time labels at edges.
layout.controls: Bottom center (if needed) or abstract EQ bars behind the track info.

spotify_screen.motion: Progress bar smoothly advances based on local millis() interpolation. Tiny EQ bars bounce randomly if is_playing is true.
spotify_screen.interactions: Tap the center to Play/Pause. Swipe left/right skips tracks (intercepts page change if swiped quickly in the center area, else changes page).
spotify_screen.rendering_notes: The ESP8266 will struggle with full RGB565 album art if pushed at once. Host script will chunk the 120x120 image. Use pushImage() for chunks. Use a dedicated dirty rect for the progress bar to ensure smooth 15+ FPS movement.
spotify_screen.prompt: A modern Spotify 'Now Playing' dashboard on a 320x240 dark display. Left side features vibrant, sharp album square art. Right side has the song title 'Starboy', artist name, and a sleek horizontal progress bar in Spotify green. A few subtle audio visualizer bars sit faintly in the background. It feels fluid, rich, and musical.
spotify_screen.motion_prompt: The album art breathes with a 1% scale-up pulse softly. The progress bar fluidly moves rightward. Tiny audio bars in the background jump actively.
